gaps.text: Autel says continue to reconnect after signal loss; incident reports claim Return To Home failed.
C2 link restored within 10 seconds returns control; incident reports claim platform not recovered.
FAA guidance requires contingency procedures for loss of control link; incident reports claim platform not located after loss.

text: FAA guidance says, when the control link is lost, attempt to reestablish it and, if unsuccessful, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link. Autel manuals state the drone will continue to attempt reconnection during auto RTH, that a new C2 link requires the user to pause or pull the pitch stick to regain control, and that C2 restoration within 10 seconds returns control. Incident reports are unverified accounts noting the platform flew away after control input, that Return To Home failed, and that the platform has not been located. Gaps: it is unclear whether reconnection guarantees control return, whether rapid C2 restoration resolves control, and whether the platform can be located after loss.
